blocks.en: The goal of this section is the following result.
blocks.zh: 本节的目标是以下结果.

blocks.en:
Assume that $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$). Let $M=\sup_Du$ ($M=\inf_Du$). Assume that $u=M$ at a point $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)\in D$ and that one of the following holds:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $c=0$ and $M$ is arbitrary,
\item $c\leq0$ and $M\geq0$ ($M\leq0$),
\item $M=0$ and $c$ is arbitrary.
\end{enumerate}
Then $u=M$ on $\overline\Omega\times[0,t_0]$.
blocks.zh:
假设 $Lu\geq0$ ($Lu\leq0$). 令 $M=\sup_Du$ ($M=\inf_Du$). 假设在点 $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)\in D$ 处 $u=M$, 并且以下条件之一成立:
\begin{enumerate}
\item $c=0$, 而 $M$ 任意,
\item $c\leq0$ 且 $M\geq0$ ($M\leq0$),
\item $M=0$, 而 $c$ 任意.
\end{enumerate}
那么在 $\overline\Omega\times[0,t_0]$ 上 $u=M$.
blocks.label: thm:parabolic-strong-maximum

blocks.en: The proof follows from three lemmas. From now on, we always assume $Lu\geq0$ without explicitly stating so; the case $Lu\leq0$ obviously follows by substituting $-u$ for $u$. The following lemma is immediate from Lemma~\ref{lem:elliptic-boundary-point} and Remark~\ref{rem:boundary-point-semidefinite}.
blocks.zh: 证明由三个引理得出. 从现在起, 始终假设 $Lu\geq0$ 而不再明确陈述; 显然, 以 $-u$ 代替 $u$ 即得 $Lu\leq0$ 的情形. 以下引理直接由 Lemma~\ref{lem:elliptic-boundary-point} 和 Remark~\ref{rem:boundary-point-semidefinite} 得出.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $B\subset\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ be a ball with $\overline B\subset D$ and suppose $u<M$ in $B$ and $u(\bm{x}_0,t_0)=M$, where $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)\in\partial B$. Then $t_0$ is either the smallest or the largest value which $t$ assumes in $\overline B$.
blocks.zh: 设 $B\subset\mathbb{R}^{n+1}$ 为球, 满足 $\overline B\subset D$, 并假设 $B$ 内 $u<M$, 且 $u(\bm{x}_0,t_0)=M$, 其中 $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)\in\partial B$. 那么 $t_0$ 是 $t$ 在 $\overline B$ 中取得的最小值或最大值.
blocks.label: lem:parabolic-ball-extreme-time

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Next we show that if $u<M$ at any point $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)$ in $Q$, then $u<M$ on all of $\Omega\times\{t_0\}$.
blocks.zh: 接下来证明, 若在 $Q$ 内某点 $(\bm{x}_0,t_0)$ 处 $u<M$, 则在整个 $\Omega\times\{t_0\}$ 上 $u<M$.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $u(\bm{x}_0,t_0)<M$, where $\bm{x}_0\in\Omega$ and $t_0\in(0,T)$. Then $u(\bm{x},t_0)<M$ for every $\bm{x}\in\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $u(\bm{x}_0,t_0)<M$, 其中 $\bm{x}_0\in\Omega$ 且 $t_0\in(0,T)$. 那么对每个 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$, 都有 $u(\bm{x},t_0)<M$.
blocks.label: lem:parabolic-slice-strictness

blocks.en: The final lemma which we require is the following.
blocks.zh: 所需的最后一个引理如下.

blocks.en: Let $0\leq t_0<t_1\leq T$ and assume that $u<M$ in $\Omega\times(t_0,t_1)$. Then $u<M$ on $\Omega\times\{t_1\}$.
blocks.zh: 设 $0\leq t_0<t_1\leq T$, 并假设在 $\Omega\times(t_0,t_1)$ 内 $u<M$. 那么在 $\Omega\times\{t_1\}$ 上 $u<M$.
blocks.label: lem:parabolic-time-strictness

blocks.en: The proof of the theorem is now clear. For every $t>0$, we have either $u(\bm{x},t)=M$ or $u(\bm{x},t)<M$ for all $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:parabolic-slice-strictness}). The set $Z$ of all $t$\textquotesingle s for which $u<M$ is open and hence a countable union of intervals. By Lemma~\ref{lem:parabolic-time-strictness} none of these intervals can have an upper endpoint. The only possibility is then that $Z=(t_0,T]$ for some $t_0$, which is the claim of the theorem.
blocks.zh: 现在定理的证明已清楚. 对每个 $t>0$, 或者对所有 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 都有 $u(\bm{x},t)=M$, 或者对所有这些点都有 $u(\bm{x},t)<M$ (Lemma~\ref{lem:parabolic-slice-strictness}). 所有使 $u<M$ 的 $t$ 构成的集合 $Z$ 是开的, 因而是可数个区间的并. 由 Lemma~\ref{lem:parabolic-time-strictness}, 这些区间都不能有上端点. 唯一的可能性就是对某个 $t_0$, 有 $Z=(t_0,T]$, 这正是定理的结论.

blocks.en: Finally we remark that if $\partial\Omega$ is of class $C^2$ and $u$ is $C^1$ up to the boundary, then Lemma~\ref{lem:elliptic-boundary-point} applies, i.e., if $\bm{x}_0\in\partial\Omega$, $t\in(0,T)$, $u(\bm{x}_0,t)=M$, but $u(\bm{x},t)<M$ for $\bm{x}\in\Omega$, then $\partial u/\partial n(\bm{x}_0,t)>0$.
blocks.zh: 最后指出, 若 $\partial\Omega$ 属于 $C^2$ 类, 且 $u$ 直到边界都为 $C^1$ 的, 则 Lemma~\ref{lem:elliptic-boundary-point} 适用, 即若 $\bm{x}_0\in\partial\Omega$, $t\in(0,T)$, $u(\bm{x}_0,t)=M$, 但对 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 有 $u(\bm{x},t)<M$, 则 $\partial u/\partial n(\bm{x}_0,t)>0$.

blocks.en: Assume that $\Omega$ is bounded, $\partial\Omega$ is of class $C^2$ and that $u,v\in C^2(D)\cap C^1(\overline D)$. Assume, moreover, that $Lu\leq Lv$ for $(\bm{x},t)\in D$, that $u(\bm{x},0)\geq v(\bm{x},0)$ for $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ and that $\partial u/\partial n\geq\partial v/\partial n$ for $(\bm{x},t)\in\partial\Omega\times(0,T)$. Show that $u\geq v$ in $D$.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\Omega$ 有界, $\partial\Omega$ 属于 $C^2$ 类, 且 $u,v\in C^2(D)\cap C^1(\overline D)$. 再假设对 $(\bm{x},t)\in D$ 有 $Lu\leq Lv$, 对 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 有 $u(\bm{x},0)\geq v(\bm{x},0)$, 并且对 $(\bm{x},t)\in\partial\Omega\times(0,T)$ 有 $\partial u/\partial n\geq\partial v/\partial n$. 证明在 $D$ 内 $u\geq v$.
blocks.label: ex:parabolic-neumann-comparison

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Assume that $\Omega$ is bounded, $f\leq0$ and that $f$ and the coefficients of $L$ are independent of $t$. We consider the equation $Lu=f$ with boundary conditions $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega\times(0,\infty)$. An equilibrium solution is a solution which does not depend on time. An equilibrium solution $v$ is called stable if, for every continuous function $u_0(\bm{x})$ satisfying $u_0=0$ on $\partial\Omega$, there is a solution $u$ satisfying $Lu=f$ in $\Omega\times(0,\infty)$, $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega\times(0,\infty)$ and $u(\bm{x},0)=u_0(\bm{x})$ for $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ and, moreover, $u(\bm{x},t)\to v(\bm{x})$ as $t\to\infty$. Show that a stable equilibrium solution must be non-negative.
blocks.zh: 假设 $\Omega$ 有界, $f\leq0$, 且 $f$ 及 $L$ 的系数均不依赖于 $t$. 考虑方程 $Lu=f$, 边界条件为在 $\partial\Omega\times(0,\infty)$ 上 $u=0$. 平衡解是一个不依赖于时间的解. 若对每个满足在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u_0=0$ 的连续函数 $u_0(\bm{x})$, 都存在解 $u$, 满足在 $\Omega\times(0,\infty)$ 内 $Lu=f$, 在 $\partial\Omega\times(0,\infty)$ 上 $u=0$, 对 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 有 $u(\bm{x},0)=u_0(\bm{x})$, 并且当 $t\to\infty$ 时 $u(\bm{x},t)\to v(\bm{x})$, 则称平衡解 $v$ 稳定. 证明稳定的平衡解必为非负.
blocks.label: ex:parabolic-stable-equilibrium-nonnegative

blocks.en: Let $D=\mathbb{R}^n\times(0,T]$. Let $u\in C^2(D)\cap C(\overline D)$ be a bounded solution of the heat equation $u_t=\Delta u$. Show that $\sup_Du\leq\sup_{\mathbb{R}^n}u(\cdot,0)$. Hint: Consider the function $v=u-\epsilon(2nt+|\bm{x}|^2)$.
blocks.zh: 令 $D=\mathbb{R}^n\times(0,T]$. 设 $u\in C^2(D)\cap C(\overline D)$ 为热方程 $u_t=\Delta u$ 的有界解. 证明 $\sup_Du\leq\sup_{\mathbb{R}^n}u(\cdot,0)$. Hint: 考虑函数 $v=u-\epsilon(2nt+|\bm{x}|^2)$.
blocks.label: ex:whole-space-bounded-heat-maximum

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be bounded, and let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be of class $C^1$. Let $u_0\in C(\overline\Omega)$ be such that $u_0=0$ on $\partial\Omega$. Prove that the equation $u_t=\Delta u+f(u)$, subject to the boundary condition $u=0$ on $\partial\Omega$ and the initial condition $u(\bm{x},0)=u_0(\bm{x})$, has at most one solution on $\Omega\times(0,T)$, for any $T>0$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 有界, 且 $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ 属于 $C^1$ 类. 设 $u_0\in C(\overline\Omega)$, 在 $\partial\Omega$ 上满足 $u_0=0$. 证明对任意 $T>0$, 方程 $u_t=\Delta u+f(u)$ 在边界条件为 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=0$, 初始条件为 $u(\bm{x},0)=u_0(\bm{x})$ 时, 在 $\Omega\times(0,T)$ 上至多有一个解.
blocks.label: ex:semilinear-parabolic-uniqueness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be bounded and let $f,g:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}$ be of class $C^1$. Let $u$, $v$ satisfy the equations $u_t=\Delta u+f(u,v)$, $v_t=\Delta v+g(u,v)$ on $\Omega\times(0,T)$, with boundary conditions $u=v=0$ on $\partial\Omega$. Assume that $f(0,v)\geq0$ for every $v$ and that $g(u,0)\geq0$ for every $u$. Show that if $u(\bm{x},0)\geq0$, $v(\bm{x},0)\geq0$ for every $\bm{x}\in\Omega$, then $u\geq0$, $v\geq0$. Systems of the kind described here arise in reaction-diffusion problems and in mathematical biology, where $u$ and $v$ denote concentrations or populations of species.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 有界, 且 $f,g:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}$ 属于 $C^1$ 类. 设 $u$, $v$ 在 $\Omega\times(0,T)$ 上满足方程 $u_t=\Delta u+f(u,v)$, $v_t=\Delta v+g(u,v)$, 边界条件为 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=v=0$. 假设对每个 $v$ 都有 $f(0,v)\geq0$, 且对每个 $u$ 都有 $g(u,0)\geq0$. 证明, 若对每个 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 都有 $u(\bm{x},0)\geq0$, $v(\bm{x},0)\geq0$, 则 $u\geq0$, $v\geq0$. 这里描述的这类系统出现在反应扩散问题和数学生物学中, 其中 $u$ 与 $v$ 表示物种的浓度或种群数量.
blocks.label: ex:reaction-diffusion-positivity
